ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan Core
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development build of Ancient & Medieval Japan Core.
Extends Medieval Overhaul with agriculture, primary processing, materials, and village-life systems inspired by pre-Edo Japan. Medieval Overhaul is required.
The current development slice begins with field-crop agriculture. Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaul is optional; when present, AMJ crops use its explicit cold-death framework.
Save compatibility: Adding to or removing from existing saves has not been verified. This development build adds custom crops, items, and processing content; safe removal is not guaranteed.
